research_basis: OWASP LLM08:2025 Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
2025-2026 financial-services deepfake, payment-fraud, and agentic supply-chain reporting

scenarios.title: AI Asset Classification and Crown-Jewel Mapping
scenarios.objective: Classify model, data, tool, identity, ledger, and control-plane assets so an AI security decision cannot silently cross asset boundaries.

scenarios.title: Threat Model Baseline and Abuse-Case Register
scenarios.objective: Build a reproducible abuse-case baseline for an agentic banking workflow before testing any attack path.

scenarios.title: Secret Boundary and Synthetic Credential Handling
scenarios.objective: Distinguish synthetic training tokens, service keys, and learner credentials while proving that evidence collection does not become secret exposure.

scenarios.title: Evidence Replay and Chain-of-Custody Integrity
scenarios.objective: Detect tampered or replayed evidence before it can satisfy a later training or approval decision.

scenarios.title: Localhost SSRF Safety Boundary
scenarios.objective: Model a server-side fetch request without contacting external infrastructure and verify that localhost-only policy remains explicit.

scenarios.title: Trust Boundary Crossing Map
scenarios.objective: Trace user input, retrieved evidence, tool output, and approval data through a synthetic bank workflow without merging trust classes.

scenarios.title: AI Risk Register and Control Ownership
scenarios.objective: Map each high-impact failure mode to an accountable control owner, evidence source, and safe response state.

scenarios.title: Instructor Scope and Cohort Isolation
scenarios.objective: Verify that instructor actions, learner tokens, cohorts, and reset operations remain isolated and auditable.

scenarios.title: MCP Registry and Skill Inventory
scenarios.objective: Inventory connected MCP servers and agent skills, including provenance, version, capabilities, and declared trust level.

scenarios.title: A2A Agent Card Capability Recon
scenarios.objective: Compare advertised agent-card capabilities with the actual delegated surface and identify privilege drift.

scenarios.title: OpenAPI Schema Drift and Hidden Operations
scenarios.objective: Find an undocumented synthetic operation created by schema drift and classify whether the caller is authorized to see it.

scenarios.title: WebSocket Event and Session Recon
scenarios.objective: Map synthetic real-time events, session binding, and replay identifiers without issuing a financial side effect.

scenarios.title: Agent Skill Marketplace Recon
scenarios.objective: Identify the metadata, publisher, permissions, and update channel that make an agent skill discoverable and deployable.

scenarios.title: Multi-Turn Goal Drift and Commitment Trap
scenarios.objective: Demonstrate how harmless turns can gradually move an assistant away from its approved banking objective.

scenarios.title: Inbound Email Instruction Injection
scenarios.objective: Separate customer email content from trusted workflow instructions when an agent summarizes a synthetic service mailbox.

scenarios.title: Unicode Homoglyph and Delimiter Confusion
scenarios.objective: Detect instruction-like content hidden by Unicode normalization, confusable characters, or delimiter abuse.

scenarios.title: Multilingual Instruction-Hierarchy Attack
scenarios.objective: Test whether policy and safety controls remain consistent when the same synthetic instruction is expressed across languages.

scenarios.title: Structured Tool-Call Prompt Injection
scenarios.objective: Prevent user-controlled structured content from manufacturing a tool call or altering a typed banking operation.

scenarios.title: System Instruction Extraction and Boundary Proof
scenarios.objective: Measure prompt disclosure without exposing real secrets and prove that disclosure does not equal authorization.

scenarios.title: Single-Document CorruptRAG Poisoning
scenarios.objective: Demonstrate how one high-ranking poisoned synthetic document can redirect a targeted answer and how source quarantine limits impact.

scenarios.title: Query Rewrite and Retrieval Intent Hijack
scenarios.objective: Detect a malicious query rewrite that changes the customer or policy scope before vector retrieval begins.

scenarios.title: Vector Store ACL and Metadata Filter Bypass
scenarios.objective: Test whether metadata filters are enforced server-side instead of trusted from a caller-supplied retrieval request.

scenarios.title: RAG Retrieval Cache Poisoning
scenarios.objective: Detect a stale or cross-tenant cached retrieval result that survives a policy or identity change.

scenarios.title: Citation and Provenance Spoofing
scenarios.objective: Verify that a citation points to the retrieved source actually used, not a trusted-looking synthetic citation supplied by an attacker.

scenarios.title: MCP OAuth Resource and Audience Confusion
scenarios.objective: Prevent an MCP client from presenting a token issued for one resource to a different synthetic tool server.

scenarios.title: A2A Signature and Transport Downgrade
scenarios.objective: Detect an agent message that falls back from a bound signature to an unauthenticated transport path.

scenarios.title: Recursive Delegation and Agent Loop Exhaustion
scenarios.objective: Stop mutually delegating synthetic agents from exceeding bounded loop, retry, and approval budgets.

scenarios.title: Agent Webhook Replay and Nonce Binding
scenarios.objective: Verify that a synthetic approval webhook cannot be replayed against another operation, learner, or branch.

scenarios.title: Tool Result Integrity and Receipt Tampering
scenarios.objective: Detect a modified tool result or receipt before it can influence a synthetic settlement decision.

scenarios.title: Memory Write Authorization and Provenance
scenarios.objective: Require explicit scope and provenance before an agent can persist a customer-affecting memory.

scenarios.title: Summary Lineage Break and False Consensus
scenarios.objective: Find where summarization drops source identity or turns repeated untrusted claims into apparent consensus.

scenarios.title: Feedback Memory Amplification
scenarios.objective: Detect a poisoned recommendation that is repeatedly promoted by feedback and becomes a trusted future instruction.

scenarios.title: Stale PII and Retention Boundary
scenarios.objective: Prove that deleted or restricted synthetic customer attributes do not remain retrievable through long-term memory.

scenarios.title: Context Cache Cross-Tenant Recall
scenarios.objective: Test whether a cached context packet can be replayed by another synthetic customer, employee, or branch.

scenarios.title: Memory Deletion and Tombstone Failure
scenarios.objective: Detect a deletion request that removes the visible record but leaves a retrievable derived memory or summary.

scenarios.title: OIDC Issuer Mix-Up and Agent Audience Confusion
scenarios.objective: Detect a valid-looking identity assertion issued by the wrong synthetic issuer or intended for the wrong agent audience.

scenarios.title: JWT Algorithm and Key-Confusion Boundary
scenarios.objective: Prove that a synthetic token verifier pins algorithm, issuer, key type, and audience instead of trusting token headers.

scenarios.title: Non-Human Service Account Key Reuse
scenarios.objective: Detect a service identity reused across branches, workflows, or environments beyond its declared audience.

scenarios.title: Just-in-Time Role Drift and Approval Expiry
scenarios.objective: Verify that a temporary high-risk role expires and cannot be reused after its approval window or operation changes.

scenarios.title: Agent Skill Registry Poisoning
scenarios.objective: Detect a malicious or look-alike skill package that requests broader tools than its declared banking task requires.

scenarios.title: Container Model Layer and Runtime Tamper
scenarios.objective: Correlate a changed container or model layer with a runtime manifest mismatch before a worker can load it.

scenarios.title: Detector Model Drift and Calibration Failure
scenarios.objective: Identify when a detector's behavior changes after model or feature drift and establish a safe recalibration checkpoint.

scenarios.title: Alert Fatigue and Suppression Abuse
scenarios.objective: Detect an attacker or workflow that suppresses repeated alerts until a high-risk synthetic operation passes unnoticed.

scenarios.title: Adaptive Velocity and Risk-Threshold Evasion
scenarios.objective: Detect a distributed low-and-slow synthetic transaction pattern that remains below single-request thresholds.

scenarios.title: Multi-Agent Collusion and False Consensus
scenarios.objective: Correlate several synthetic agents that reinforce the same unsafe banking recommendation while hiding the original poisoned source.

scenarios.title: Agentic Payment Intent and Authorization Confusion
scenarios.objective: Separate a customer intent, an agent recommendation, a human authorization, and virtual settlement when their details disagree.

scenarios.title: Synthetic Mule-Network Funds Flow
scenarios.objective: Trace a virtual funds flow across accounts and branches, identify mule-like graph behavior, and preserve privacy-safe evidence.

scenarios.title: Recovery Verification and Rollback Integrity
scenarios.objective: Detect a recovery workflow that reports success while a poisoned tool, memory, or identity remains active.

scenarios.title: APT Evidence-Custody Break and Residual Risk
scenarios.objective: Prove that a campaign conclusion is invalid when timeline, identity, retrieval, and ledger evidence cannot be independently reconciled.
